title: Actively exploited sandbox RCE in all Chromium versions
summary:
The provided title indicates a critical, actively exploited security vulnerability affecting all versions of Chromium-based browsers.

This vulnerability is described as a "sandbox RCE" (Remote Code Execution). Remote Code Execution means an attacker can execute arbitrary code on a user's system. The "sandbox" refers to Chromium's security mechanism designed to isolate browser processes and limit their access to the underlying operating system. An RCE *within* the sandbox signifies a significant bypass of this security layer, potentially paving the way for further system compromise.

The term "actively exploited" is particularly concerning, as it means threat actors are already leveraging this vulnerability in real-world attacks. Its presence "in all Chromium versions" highlights a widespread impact across browsers like Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera, and others built on the Chromium engine.

The reference "NVD - Home" suggests that detailed information about this vulnerability, including its CVE (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures) identifier, severity scores, and patching details, would be available on the National Vulnerability Database, highlighting its official recognition and urgency. Users and administrators of Chromium-based browsers are advised to apply security updates immediately to mitigate this high-risk flaw.
chinese_title: 所有 Chromium 版本中被主动利用的沙盒RCE
chinese_summary:
所提供的标题表明存在一个影响所有基于 Chromium 浏览器版本的严重且正在被积极利用的安全漏洞。

此漏洞被描述为“沙盒远程代码执行”（RCE）。远程代码执行意味着攻击者可以在用户的系统上执行任意代码。“沙盒”是指 Chromium 的一种安全机制，旨在隔离浏览器进程并限制它们对底层操作系统的访问。沙盒内的 RCE 意味着该安全层被严重绕过，可能为进一步的系统入侵铺平道路。

“正在被积极利用”一词尤其令人担忧，因为它意味着威胁行为者已在实际攻击中利用此漏洞。其存在于“所有 Chromium 版本中”突显了对 Google Chrome、Microsoft Edge、Brave、Opera 等基于 Chromium 引擎的浏览器造成的广泛影响。

“NVD - 主页”的引用表明，有关此漏洞的详细信息，包括其 CVE（通用漏洞披露）标识符、严重性评分和补丁详情，可在国家漏洞数据库中查阅，这凸显了其官方认可度和紧迫性。建议基于 Chromium 的浏览器用户和管理员立即应用安全更新，以缓解此高风险缺陷。

title: Nitter has more working instances than before the takedowns
summary:
The Codeberg wiki page titled "Instances" functions as a live, comprehensive tracker for public Nitter instances. It monitors a multitude of Nitter servers, providing real-time status updates on whether each is online or offline. The page also includes detailed statistics such as instance health and their 30-day average uptime.

According to the page's latest update, 147 Nitter instances are currently being tracked, with 104 reported as online and 43 offline. The average uptime across these instances over the past month stands at 83.27%. The tracker notes that instances may go offline due to various reasons, including Twitter's API rate limits or server-side operational issues. Its primary purpose is to serve as a dynamic resource, helping users identify and access functional Nitter instances for anonymously browsing Twitter content.
chinese_title: Nitter 有比被下架前更多的运行实例。
chinese_summary:
Codeberg上名为“Instances”的维基页面是一个实时、全面的公共Nitter实例追踪器。它监控着大量的Nitter服务器，提供每个实例在线或离线的实时状态更新。该页面还包括详细的统计数据，例如实例的健康状况及其30天平均在线时间。

根据该页面的最新更新，目前正在追踪147个Nitter实例，其中104个报告为在线，43个离线。过去一个月，这些实例的平均在线时间为83.27%。该追踪器指出，实例可能因多种原因下线，包括Twitter的API速率限制或服务器端操作问题。其主要目的是作为一个动态资源，帮助用户识别并访问可用的Nitter实例，以便匿名浏览Twitter内容。

title: Private German rocket makes history, reaches orbit from European soil
summary:
On September 5, 2026, Isar Aerospace's Spectrum rocket made history by becoming the first to reach orbit from Western European soil. Launching from the Andøya Space Center in northern Norway, the German company's 95-foot-tall "Onward and Upward" rocket successfully achieved an elliptical orbit just over seven minutes after its 4:12 p.m. EDT liftoff.

This achievement followed a challenging path. Spectrum's debut flight in March 2025, dubbed "Going Full Spectrum," failed less than a minute after launch due to an unintended vent valve opening and loss of attitude control. Isar Aerospace rigorously investigated the anomaly and implemented fixes for its second attempt, which faced multiple delays from January to June 2026 due to technical issues, adverse weather, and other obstacles.

On its successful flight, Spectrum carried five cubesats and one scientific experiment. After reaching its initial elliptical orbit, it performed a circularization burn and successfully deployed all payloads, marking full mission success. Isar Aerospace plans for Spectrum, which can carry 2,200 pounds to low Earth orbit, to become a workhorse for small to medium-size satellites, with a manufacturing capacity of over 30 rockets per year. While Russia has launched from its European territory for decades, this event marks a significant first for Western Europe.
chinese_title: 德国私营火箭创造历史，从欧洲本土成功入轨。
chinese_summary:
2026年9月5日，Isar Aerospace公司的Spectrum火箭创造了历史，成为首枚从西欧大陆发射并成功进入轨道的火箭。这家德国公司高95英尺（约29米）、名为“Onward and Upward”的火箭，从挪威北部的安岛航天中心发射升空，在美国东部时间下午4点12分点火后仅七分多钟，便成功进入椭圆轨道。

这一成就并非一帆风顺。Spectrum火箭的首次飞行（代号“Going Full Spectrum”）发生在2025年3月，由于意外的排气阀打开和姿态失控，火箭在发射后不到一分钟便宣告失败。Isar Aerospace对此次异常进行了严密调查，并为第二次尝试实施了修复措施，然而，第二次尝试却因技术问题、恶劣天气及其他障碍，从2026年1月推迟至6月，多次遭遇延误。

在这次成功的飞行中，Spectrum火箭搭载了五颗立方星和一项科学实验。在进入初始椭圆轨道后，它进行了近圆化变轨，并成功部署了所有有效载荷，标志着任务圆满成功。Isar Aerospace计划让Spectrum火箭（其运载能力为2,200磅（约1,000公斤）至近地轨道）成为中小型卫星的主力运载工具，每年可生产超过30枚火箭。尽管俄罗斯几十年来一直从其欧洲领土发射火箭，但此次事件对西欧而言，具有开创性的重要意义。

title: Cloud in a Bottle: making self-hosting accessible to everyone
summary:
"Cloud in a Bottle" aims to solve the widespread frustration with modern cloud software, citing issues like misaligned incentives, tracking, ads, and "enshittification." The author argues that while cloud software offers convenience, its centralized nature makes it costly for open-source creators and shifts control away from users, while existing self-hosting solutions are either unapproachable, insecure, or lacking crucial features.

Cloud in a Bottle is an open-source personal cloud platform designed to make self-hosting accessible and user-friendly. It runs containerized applications on an Ubuntu machine, routing requests via a web server. These apps operate in secure, rootless, hardened containers, allowing existing software to run with minimal changes.

Beyond basic hosting, the platform offers opt-in features to create a "cloud smartphone" experience. This includes unified authentication, allowing users to log in once to their instance and gain automatic access to all their applications. It also provides an API for permissioned data and capability sharing between apps, similar to how mobile OS APIs enable integrated experiences.

The project is open source, self-hostable, and committed to zero telemetry and simplicity. A managed version is offered by Imbue to ensure accessibility and project sustainability, though the self-hosted path remains first-class. Cloud in a Bottle seeks to catalyze the creation of more high-quality open-source web software, aspiring to become increasingly accessible to a broad audience beyond just tech enthusiasts as its curated app catalog grows and the platform matures.
chinese_title: 瓶中云：让自托管人人可及
chinese_summary:
“瓶中云”旨在解决人们对现代云软件普遍存在的不满，列举了诸如激励机制错位、跟踪、广告以及“平台劣质化”等问题。作者认为，尽管云软件提供了便利，但其中心化特性却使开源创作者付出高昂代价，并使控制权从用户手中转移；而现有的自托管解决方案则存在难以使用、不安全或缺乏关键功能的问题。

“瓶中云”是一个开源的个人云平台，旨在让自托管变得易于访问且用户友好。它在Ubuntu机器上运行容器化应用程序，并通过网络服务器路由请求。这些应用程序在安全、无根、强化的容器中运行，使得现有软件只需极少改动即可运行。

除了基本的托管功能，该平台还提供可选功能，旨在打造“云智能手机”体验。这包括统一认证，允许用户一次登录其实例，即可自动访问所有应用程序。它还提供了一个API，用于应用程序之间的数据和能力共享，这类似于移动操作系统API如何实现集成体验。

该项目是开源的、可自托管的，并致力于零遥测和简洁性。Imbue公司提供了一个托管版本，以确保可访问性和项目可持续性，尽管自托管路径仍然是首选。随着其精选应用程序目录的增长和平台的成熟，“瓶中云”力求促进更多高质量开源Web软件的创建，并期望在技术爱好者之外，变得越来越易于广大受众使用。

title: Record-High 89% in U.S. Say Government Corruption Widespread
summary:
A recent Gallup poll indicates a record-high 89% of U.S. adults believe government corruption is widespread in 2026, a 10-point jump from last year and the highest in 20 years. This surge is largely driven by Democrats, whose perception of widespread corruption rose sharply from 57% in 2024 (Biden's final year) to 91% in 2026 (Trump's second term), aligning with Independents at 90%. Republicans' views remained more consistent, around 83%, suggesting an underlying concern less dependent on the party in power.

The U.S. increasingly diverges from other advanced economies. While the median perceived corruption in OECD countries has fallen to 59% by 2025, the U.S. reached 79% that year, topping the OECD rankings even before the current increase. At 89%, the U.S. now outranks nearly all 132 countries Gallup surveys annually, with only a few isolated exceptions.

Moreover, perceptions of government corruption (89%) are significantly higher than those for businesses (71%) in the U.S., creating an 18-point gap – the largest in the trend. This record high reflects a "shared alarm" and a near convergence of bipartisan concern, as Democrats' views on government corruption have now risen to levels similar to Republicans'.
chinese_title: 美国89%民众称政府腐败普遍，创历史新高
chinese_summary:
盖洛普最新民调显示，2026年有高达89%的美国成年人认为政府腐败普遍存在，创历史新高，比去年上升了10个百分点，也是20年来的最高水平。这一激增主要由民主党人推动，他们认为腐败普遍存在的比例从2024年（拜登任期最后一年）的57%急剧上升到2026年（特朗普第二任期）的91%，与独立人士的90%持平。共和党人的观点则保持相对稳定，约为83%，这表明他们对此的深层担忧较少受执政党的影响。

美国与其他发达经济体的分歧日益增大。尽管到2025年，经合组织（OECD）国家的腐败普遍存在的中位数认知已降至59%，但美国同年达到79%，甚至在当前增长之前就已位居经合组织排名榜首。目前，美国以89%的比例，超越了盖洛普每年调查的近132个国家中的几乎所有国家，仅有少数例外。

此外，美国民众对政府腐败的认知（89%）明显高于对商业腐败的认知（71%），形成了18个百分点的差距——这是该趋势中最大的差距。这一历史新高反映出一种“共同的警报”以及两党担忧的趋同，因为民主党人对政府腐败的看法现在已上升到与共和党人相似的水平。

title: The revolt of the reader
summary:
The author, a proponent of long-form reading and writing, expresses deep frustration with the proliferation of LLM-authored content, arguing it exasperates readers and voids the social contract between writer and reader. He asserts that readers can easily detect AI-generated text due to its structural tells and grating stylistic tics. A survey by Cynthia Dunlop supports this, showing 78% of readers stop immediately and 71% avoid the author in the future, with 98% preferring imperfect human writing over LLM-polished pieces.

Comparing it to the arc of email spam, the author predicts that LLM-authored content will become increasingly ineffective as readers actively repel it. He highlights Pangram Labs' Pangram 4 model as a highly effective tool for detecting AI-written text, noting its "astonishingly low false positive and false negative rates."

As a result, the author's company, Oxide, now mandates that all public writing be verified as human-authored by Pangram to ensure reader confidence. He urges other organizations to adopt similar policies to maintain authenticity. The article concludes by advising writers: readers are revolting and will use detectors like Pangram. Instead of letting LLMs write for you, use prompts as a skeleton for your own writing, or leverage LLMs primarily as editors, if you wish your work to be genuinely read.
chinese_title: 读者反叛
chinese_summary:
作者作为长篇阅读和写作的倡导者，对LLM（大型语言模型）生成内容泛滥深感沮丧，认为这会激怒读者并破坏作者与读者之间的社会契约。他断言，读者可以轻易地识别出AI生成文本，因为它具有结构上的特征和令人不快的文体习惯。辛西娅·邓洛普（Cynthia Dunlop）的一项调查支持了这一点，调查显示78%的读者会立即停止阅读，71%的读者将来会避开该作者，98%的读者更喜欢不完美的真人写作，而非LLM润色过的作品。

作者将其与电子邮件垃圾邮件的发展轨迹进行比较，预测随着读者积极抵制，LLM生成的内容将变得越来越无效。他强调Pangram Labs的Pangram 4模型是检测AI文本的高效工具，并指出其“惊人低的误报率和漏报率”。

因此，作者的公司Oxide现在强制要求所有公开写作都必须经Pangram验证为人工创作，以确保读者的信任。他敦促其他组织采取类似政策以保持真实性。文章最后建议作家：读者正在抵制，并将使用像Pangram这样的检测工具。如果你希望你的作品被真正阅读，就不要让LLM为你写作，而是将提示用作自己写作的骨架，或主要利用LLM作为编辑。
